text: Done at c6f94953/ffbeeb45/0b0b5b15 (cherry-picked from agent worktree cf46fecd/8f3e970d/70c35527). ItkAffine.scala+suite and ItkHdf5TransformReader(+AntsHdf5TransformAdapter)+suites removed (git rm); TransformAssetLoader reduced 896->~250 lines as a thin spatial adapter over TransformFiles.load + format interpretations; SpatialIngest/TransformDescriptor/FmriprepSpatialGraph remain in spatial; SHA-256 provenance via AssetRef. Obsolete direction/convention/encoding options removed; new TransformFileEndpoints(AsFile|Reversed) records graph-edge orientation (reversed dense without inverse -> typed NoForwardMap). SimpleITK HDF5 fixtures moved to transform oracle/itk_hdf5_simpleitk with ItkHdf5SimpleItkSuite; ItkHdf5Container now refuses components missing parameter datasets (was silently zero centre). Verified on merged main: transform JVM 84/JS 67, spatial 136/116, image 353, atlas 90/62; scalafimCompileAll 0 warnings/0 errors. DEVIATIONS (agent): ITK composites become one opaque mapped edge (no per-stage count); dense default boundary Reject (tests pass PreserveSource to match ITK); AFNI aff12 now read as pullback (intrinsic) where the old default was forward; FSL geometry from domain grid affine treated as sform (wrong if FSL would pick a different affine); FNIRT coefficients and multi-row aff12 refused at ingest; legacy dataset-alias provenance flag dropped.
